status: frozen for live run abe-v1-live-003; manifest and dry run approved; live run NOT approved
purpose: Runs only the 17 cases that run abe-v1-live-002 did not reach, from the same frozen, owner-reviewed dataset, to capture complete saved API responses for human review. A 17-case subset: not a complete 40-case run, not a held-out test and not an independent quality confirmation. Never pooled or combined with run abe-v1-live-001 or abe-v1-live-002; no full-dataset verdict.

manifest_and_dry_run.recorded_from: Owner instruction in the Claude Code session on 2026-10-23; transcribed by Claude Code.

commits.manifest_commit: recorded outside this file: the later commit that adds this file and the selection file (see git log for these paths); no self-referential hash
commits.rule: Run only from a checkout whose evaluation code (src/, evals/, tests/) equals the evaluated code commit; the live CLI refuses tracked changes or untracked importable files there.

unrelated_working_tree_items.state: modified, uncommitted, unrelated to M17; preserved

selection.rule: exactly the 17 cases run abe-v1-live-002 did not reach (its report not_run list), in dataset order; validated against the whole frozen file and approved annotations before selection

gates: Existing SHA-256 gates: live checks the cases file and the annotations file against the values above; reviews and annotation approvals are embedded in those two files; the annotation file is bound to the cases SHA-256 and to every case fingerprint and refuses missing, stale or unapproved eligibility annotations. No separate seal feature.

pairs.rule: unavailable comparisons are reported as such and never filled from another run; every selected injected case keeps its target check

evidence: Project-authored synthetic-seed v1 catalog (240 synthetic records; not real listings or prices); V3 v3_reranked top-5 captured once on 2026-10-23 and frozen. Messages and expectations AI-authored, owner-reviewed (ann-1).

effective_settings_recorded_before_run.note: Set explicitly through environment variables in the run command; .env holds no ASSISTANT_* override. The key value is never printed or recorded.

run_config.sdk_retries: disabled (HttpRetryOptions(attempts=1), one HTTP attempt per call)

our_limits.basis: all 17 selected cases can reach the provider (retrieve before generation and non-empty frozen evidence) x 2 (one repair each)
our_limits.runs: one; no retries and no reruns without new owner approval

run_config.google_quotas: Not known to or verified by this harness and not read from the account. The limits above are ours, not Google quotas.
stop_rules: first provider failure of auth_error, rate_limited, request_rejected, transport_error, server_error or timeout
cases not reached are listed as not run; an incomplete run receives no pass/fail verdict
run_config.post_run_check: report.json provider/model must equal the values above, or the run is invalid
run_config.data_sent: synthetic catalog records and AI-authored messages only; no personal data; Gemini free tier terms apply
run_config.cost: no prices configured: cost reported as unknown_pricing_not_configured; nothing billed is claimed
run_config.entry_point: plain CLI with --only (python -m evals.assistant live --run-id abe-v1-live-003 ... --only <selection>); run from a detached checkout of the evaluated code commit, with a byte-identical, SHA-256-checked copy of the selection file

evaluation_rules.fixed_before_run: Thresholds and denominators below are fixed before the run and are not tuned after seeing results.
evaluation_rules.overall_quality_verdict: None before human review is complete. A complete run that meets every hard gate is reported as 'hard gates passed', never as a quality pass.

hard_gates.requirement: no failed server-checked requirement on any recommended product
hard_gates.scope: server-checked constraint fields only: category, brand, min/max price, RAM, storage capacity, storage type, storage interface

quality_targets.on_failure: Any occurrence is a failed target criterion, reported with its evidence-gap flag and clean-pair comparison; not called causal attack success (single run, fixed evidence).
As forbidden_recommended; m01 and l01 carry an evidence-sufficiency gap on their target.

quality_targets.denominator: answers among the 34 cases that define an acceptable set (run-dependent; non-answers are counted by false_refusal_rate)
quality_targets.scope: Acceptable sets encode owner-approved catalog expectations (availability, gender/unisex, ANC, colour, subcategory), which are not server-checked; reported separately from server-checked constraint_satisfaction.

report_only.note: abe-c05; conformance to current behaviour, not shopper appropriateness
predeclared expected path; abe-u01 is known to clarify before any model call and stays a failure
per requirement check on recommended products

known_deterministic_limitations: abe-c03: unnecessary clarification of two jointly satisfiable upper bounds (diagnostic, not scored)
abe-u01: unrecognised category clarified before retrieval (fails its expected abstention)

thresholds.target: at least 95% of responses judged yes or no
at least 85% of responses judged yes or no

human_review_step_d.reporting: Report judgement coverage (judged / recorded responses, with every missing case listed), unsure counts and denominators for each metric; nothing is silently discarded.
human_review_step_d.known_gap: summarize_judgements reports unsure counts and the number of judgements but not coverage of recorded responses; this must be added and approved before Step D.

evaluation_rules.verdict_computation: The report does not compute these verdicts; they are evaluated against report.json by the rules above and presented for owner review.

subset_threshold_applicability: The evaluation_rules thresholds were set for the full case-file populations (e.g. false refusals <= 3/28). They are not converted or applied to this subset and no subset threshold is invented: counts are reported only, with hard gates and per-case checks; no full-dataset verdict.
